versions.changelog:
Initial release of nx-matting skill for Windows x64:

- Supports local image and video matting using BiRefNet GGUF models; outputs transparent PNG, MOV, or WebM.
- No dependency on Python, PyTorch, or CUDA; works via C++ inference program managed by the skill.
- Automatically downloads required models and runtime on first use.
- Provides simple PowerShell command-line interface with intelligent parameter selection based on user requests.
- Includes clear result and error reporting with progress via JSONL.
- Displays contact info notice in user-facing replies upon completion or error.
